title: From File
text: Load data from MAT file into Simulink model, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {File name} sets MAT file name or path to MAT file; {Output data type} sets the data type of data in MAT file Inherit, {Sample time} sets the output sample period and optional time, {Data extrapolation before first data point} sets the method to determine block output before first data point in MAT file Linear, {Data interpolation within time range} sets the interpolation method Linear, {Data extrapolation after last data point} sets the method to determine block output after final data point in MAT file Linear and {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the option to enable zero-crossing detection for this. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output created using MAT file data scalar | vector | matrix | array

params.name: File name
params.values: MAT file name or path to MAT file untitled.mat (default) | MAT file name | path to MAT file

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of data in MAT file Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | Enum: | Bus: | |...

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Output sample period and optional time offset 0 | scalar | 1 -by- 2 vector

params.name: Data extrapolation before first data point
params.values: Method to determine block output before first data point in MAT file Linear extrapolation (default) | Hold first value | Ground value

params.name: Data interpolation within time range
params.values: Interpolation method Linear interpolation (default) | Zero order hold

params.name: Data extrapolation after last data point
params.values: Method to determine block output after final data point in MAT file Linear extrapolation (default) | Hold last value | Ground value

params.name: Enable zero-crossing detection
params.values: Option to enable zero-crossing detection for this block off (default) | on
